privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy for the PM TIPS learning platform
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

s1.heading: 1. Introduction
s1.p1: Welcome to the PM TIPS platform by Mordesu Studio. We are committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use the platform.

s2.heading: 2. Data we collect
s2.intro: We may collect the following types of information:
s2.item1: Account information: name, phone number, and encrypted password.
s2.item2: Usage information: purchased courses, learning progress, and quiz results.
s2.item3: Payment information: payments are processed by third-party providers; we do not store credit card data on our servers.
s2.item4: Technical information: device type, browser, and IP address for security and service improvement.

s3.heading: 3. How we use data
s3.intro: We use your data for the following purposes:
s3.item1: Creating and managing your account on the platform.
s3.item2: Providing access to purchased courses and educational content.
s3.item4: Improving the user experience and developing our services.
s3.item5: Contacting you about your account or platform updates.

s4.heading: 4. Data sharing
s4.p1: We do not sell or rent your personal data to third parties. We may share data only with service providers necessary to operate the platform (such as payment processing and hosting) or when required by law.

s5.heading: 5. Data protection
s5.p1: We take reasonable security measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. However, absolute security cannot be guaranteed for any transmission over the internet.

s6.heading: 6. Your rights
s6.item1: Access and update your personal data.
s6.item2: Request deletion of your account in accordance with applicable terms.
s6.item3: Contact us with any privacy-related inquiry.

s7.heading: 7. Cookies
s7.p1: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your login session and improve platform performance. You can control browser settings to disable some cookies.

s8.heading: 8. Policy changes
s8.p1: We may update this policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

s9.heading: 9. Contact us
s9.p1: For any questions about the privacy policy, please visit the <contactLink>Contact Us</contactLink> page.

terms.metaDescription: Terms of service for using the PM TIPS learning platform
terms.title: Terms of Service

s1.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
s1.p1: By using the PM TIPS platform by Mordesu Studio, you agree to these terms and conditions. If you do not agree to any provision, please do not use the platform.

s2.heading: 2. Service description
s2.p1: The platform provides digital educational content including courses, videos, quizzes, and other learning materials. We reserve the right to modify or discontinue any part of the service at any time.

s3.heading: 3. Account creation
s3.item1: You must provide accurate and truthful information when registering.
s3.item2: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential.
s3.item3: Sharing an account with others or using one account on multiple devices in violation of platform policy is prohibited.
s3.item4: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.

s4.heading: 4. Payments and pricing
s4.item1: All prices are shown in the local currency unless otherwise stated.
s4.item2: Access to content is granted after successful payment confirmation.
s4.item3: Refunds are subject to the <refundLink>Refund Policy</refundLink>.

s5.heading: 5. Intellectual property
s5.p1: All content on the platform (videos, text, images, quizzes) is protected by intellectual property rights. Copying, distributing, reselling, or sharing content by any means without prior written permission is prohibited.

s6.heading: 6. User conduct
s6.item1: Attempting to hack the platform or harm its systems.
s6.item2: Uploading or publishing harmful or illegal content.
s6.item3: Manipulating quiz results or assessment systems.
s6.item4: Using the platform for unauthorized commercial purposes.

s7.heading: 7. Disclaimer
s7.p1: Educational content is provided for learning and academic support. We do not guarantee specific exam or grade outcomes. The service is provided "as is" without express or implied warranties.

s8.heading: 8. Limitation of liability
s8.p1: Mordesu Studio and the PM TIPS platform shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the platform, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

s9.heading: 9. Privacy
s9.p1: Collection and use of your data is governed by the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.

s10.heading: 10. Changes
s10.p1: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes means you accept the updated terms.

s11.heading: 11. Contact
s11.p1: For any questions about these terms, please visit the <contactLink>Contact Us</contactLink> page.

refund.metaDescription: Refund and cancellation policy for the PM TIPS learning platform
refund.title: Refund Policy

s1.heading: 1. Overview
s1.p1: PM TIPS strives to provide high-quality educational content. This policy explains the terms and process for requesting refunds for courses or digital products.

s2.heading: 2. Digital products
s2.p1: Due to the nature of digital content (videos, files, quizzes), purchases are final once access is activated, except in the cases listed below.

s3.heading: 3. Eligible refund cases
s3.intro: Refund requests may be considered in the following cases:
s3.item1: Duplicate payment for the same course or product by mistake.
s3.item2: Access not activated after successful payment.
s3.item3: A technical issue preventing access that is not resolved within 7 business days.
s3.item4: Accidental course purchase with no content viewed, within 48 hours of purchase.

s4.heading: 4. Non-eligible cases
s4.item1: After viewing a substantial portion of the course or completing its quizzes.
s4.item2: Change of mind after viewing the content.
s4.item3: Issues caused by the user's device or internet connection.
s4.item4: Expiration of a subscription or time-limited access period.

s5.heading: 5. How to request a refund
s5.intro: To request a refund, contact us via the <contactLink>Contact Us</contactLink> page and provide the following:

s6.heading: 6. Processing time
s6.p1: Refund requests are reviewed within 3–5 business days. If approved, the amount is returned to the original payment method within 7–14 business days depending on the payment provider's policy.

s7.heading: 7. Subscriptions
s7.p1: For recurring subscriptions, you may cancel auto-renewal at any time and will not be charged for the next period. The current period's fee is not refunded after activation except under the conditions above.

s8.heading: 8. Changes
s8.p1: We reserve the right to modify the refund policy. Changes apply to new purchases after they are published on this page.
